measurements.tool: npx eslint (core rules: complexity, max-depth, max-params, max-nested-callbacks) run by the verifier with thresholds deliberately set to 1 so every function reports its true measured value; wc -l for file LOC.

checkPresentation_complexity.note: Spot-checked explicitly as requested: this is the largest function added by the changeset (95 lines, 3 lexical blocks A/B/C). Cyclomatic 3, params 2, nesting depth 2 — comfortably inside every threshold.

file_loc_markup.delta: -86 lines; the inline SVG scene was removed

measurements.threshold_hugging: None. No file or function in this changeset lands within 5% of any hard-fail line. The closest logic file is 149/600 LOC; the highest complexity is 4/15.

circular_dependencies.method: Not tool-derived, and deliberately not asserted as a tool number. No dependency-graph tool (madge / dependency-cruiser) is declared in agentic.config.yaml, and none would have anything to analyze: this repo has no bundler, no ES modules, and no import/export statements between site files.
circular_dependencies.evidence: `grep -n "<script" presentations/*/index.html` returns a flat, linear load order per page — mudanca-para-negocio: utils.js, cards.js, video.js, main.js; template-driven-ui: utils.js, scenario.js, practices.js, main.js. Modules communicate only by attaching to the window.Hotsite global. There is no import graph in which a cycle could exist, so the metric is structurally inapplicable rather than measured-as-zero.
circular_dependencies.changeset_effect: This commit deletes one script tag per page (hero-scene.js) and adds none.

fan_out.detail: presentations/mudanca-para-negocio/js/main.js references Hotsite.cards, Hotsite.videoPlayer, Hotsite.setupInView (3, down from 4 — Hotsite.heroScene removed). template-driven-ui/js/main.js references Hotsite.scenario, Hotsite.practices, Hotsite.setupInView (3, down from 4). Coupling decreased.

fan_in.detail: No new module is introduced that anything depends on; scripts/verify-hero-pan.cjs has no dependents.

shallow_split_check.detail: No LOC hard-fail was fixed by a file split in this changeset, so the anti-gaming rule has no trigger. Verified anyway that the change is a genuine deletion rather than a navigation-cost split: presentations/*/js/hero-scene.js (91 LOC each) was removed outright, hero.css shrank 201->140 and 182->138, and fan-out went down, not up. Nothing was forwarded to a new layer.

duplication_between_bundles.detail: The two hero.css hero-photo blocks and the two index.html <picture> blocks are near-identical. CLAUDE.md states the repo's own convention explicitly: 'Nothing is shared between presentation bundles or with the root — copy-paste, not import, is the reuse mechanism here.' The changeset conforms to the documented convention, so this is not raised as a DRY violation.

solid_findings.detail: No SOLID violation could be substantiated with a quoted offending span plus a named principle, so none is reported. Candidate smells considered and deliberately discarded as unsubstantiable: the `record` helper at scripts/verify-hero-pan.cjs:29 both formats and performs console I/O while mutating the module-level `failures` array, but at 5 lines and complexity 4 inside a single-purpose verification script this does not rise to a defensible SRP finding, and inventing one to have something to report would be worse than reporting zero.

warnings.finding: js/utils.js is now 100% unreferenced in BOTH bundles, yet is still loaded on every page load via <script src="js/utils.js"> (mudanca index.html:335, template-driven-ui index.html:437).
warnings.evidence: `git grep -n "Hotsite.utils" 979e219 -- presentations/*/js` shows the deleted hero-scene.js was the SOLE consumer of both Hotsite.utils.prefersReducedMotion() and Hotsite.utils.random() in each bundle (7 call sites per bundle, all inside hero-scene.js). Post-commit, `grep -rn "utils|prefersReducedMotion|random" presentations/*/js/ | grep -v "/js/utils.js:"` returns zero results.
warnings.impact: Two dead HTTP requests and dead global API surface on every page. Non-blocking: crosses no threshold.
warnings.fix: Either remove js/utils.js and its two <script> tags, or keep it deliberately and record why.

warnings.finding: Orphaned @keyframes left behind by the deleted SVG scene. mudanca-para-negocio: star-twinkle, blink-light, panel-track, antenna-ping, antenna-tip-pulse, flame-pulse — lines 1-30 of a 51-line file (59% of the file is dead). template-driven-ui: star-twinkle, blink-light, dash-flow, core-pulse.
warnings.evidence: For each listed keyframe, `grep -rn 'animation:[^;]*<name>|animation-name:[^;]*<name>' presentations/<slug>/css/` returns 0 references. The rules that used them (.star, .solar-array, .antenna-ring, .antenna-tip, .rocket-flame, .hub-light, .connection-line, .template-core, .core-light) were all deleted from hero.css by this commit.
warnings.impact: Dead CSS shipped to every visitor. Non-blocking: animations.css is 51/85 LOC, far under the 400 soft cap.
warnings.fix: Delete the 10 orphaned @keyframes blocks across the two animations.css files.

warnings.finding: scripts/**/*.cjs falls outside the `files` glob of eslint.static.config.mjs (["js/**/*.js", "presentations/**/*.js"]), so the static-structure gate reports a FALSE GREEN on the new script.
warnings.evidence: `npx --yes eslint --config eslint.static.config.mjs scripts/verify-hero-pan.cjs` exits 0 — but vacuously: zero rules are applied because no config block matches the path. The verifier had to re-measure complexity/depth/params with its own matching config to obtain the numbers reported above. The measured values happen to pass, but that is luck, not gating.
warnings.impact: Any future edit to the verification script itself is ungoverned by the structural gate.
warnings.fix: Add scripts/**/*.{js,cjs,mjs} to the files globs in eslint.static.config.mjs and eslint.config.mjs, and to the sast command's path list in agentic.config.yaml.

warnings.finding: The sealed spec's Notes assert '(outros usos do util em cada bundle continuam intactos)' — that other uses of Hotsite.utils survive in each bundle. This is factually false: per WD-W1 there are zero other uses, in either bundle.
warnings.impact: Informational only. The statement lives in Notes, not in acceptance_criteria or nfrs, so no acceptance criterion is invalidated and NO re-seal is required. Flagged so spec-judge is aware the premise was wrong, in case it informed the decision to keep utils.js.

requiredFixes: No blocking fix required for Stage 5 — every measured Watchdog metric is inside its threshold and no substantiable SOLID violation exists. The four WARN items above (WD-W1..WD-W4) are forward-fix, non-blocking, and should be picked up by the owning frontend build agent in a follow-up rather than gating this merge.
